sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023/Section 439 of Cr.P.C., 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.89/2025 registered at Police Station - Jamodi, District - Sidhi (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 64(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 3/4, 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has falsely been implicated in the case.

As per the prosecution case itself, it is alleged that since 2016, the applicant was committing rape upon the victim on the pretext that he will marry to the victim but she was already married as per the FIR itself and as per the allegation, last time the applicant committed rape upon the victim on 13.11.2024.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant has further submitted that the date of birth of the victim was 02.04.1999 whereas the date of birth of the applicant is 15.10.2000.
Thus, at the time of the first offence committed, the applicant himself was minor and the victim was one year elder to the applicant.
Thus, he was NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:11968 2 MCRC-8970-2025 exploited by the victim.
No case is made out.
The applicant is 24 years old at present and the FIR was lodged after 9 years which is totally false and fabricated case.
Hence, the applicant be released on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and submitted that the applicant has exploited the victim and no case for bail is made out.
Hence, the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.

6. Looking to the period of first offence and marriage of the victim, this Court deems it appropriate to release the applicant on bail, therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant-Gurusharan Patel shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the concerned Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
9.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
C.C. as per rules.
